candidate.source_tree_hash_contract: SHA-256 over every non-target regular file below modules/reframe4s-flashalign, sorted by repository-relative path, with each path and byte payload prefixed by its unsigned eight-byte big-endian length
candidate.snapshot_scope: The candidate hash covers the complete Flashalign module rather than repository HEAD alone; individual hashes bind the changed benchmark runner, raw output, tests and analysis.

identity_contract.capture_lattice: Both prepared images are resampled on one axis-aligned physical lattice spanning the union of their complete affine-derived world bounds.
identity_contract.exact_candidate: The zero-rotation, zero-world-lag identity candidate is evaluated first.
identity_contract.eligibility: Identity may skip expanded capture only when it meets the frozen overlap, structural-energy and structural-score requirements and is retained as a deterministic local maximum under the existing peak and separation rules.
identity_contract.diagnostics: Public capture evidence records identity overlap, structural score, eligibility and whether expanded capture executed.
identity_contract.rejected_development_rule: Numeric overlap, energy and score thresholds alone admitted a displaced 6 mm pair and produced 4.55 mm affine maximum landmark error; the final rule adds no tuned tolerance.

failure_evidence_contract.bounded_refinement: Each bounded nonconverged candidate retains failure status, exact work, executed pyramid levels, best selection checkpoint and final valid transform.
failure_evidence_contract.automatic_aggregation: Automatic failure sums work across every attempted candidate, preserves capture and refinement times, selects the diagnostic checkpoint deterministically and records zero audit work when no candidate converges.
failure_evidence_contract.audit: Only the selected converged candidate is audited; audit rejection retains refinement plus audit work and checkpoint evidence.
failure_evidence_contract.row_encoding: Failed schema-1.1 rows keep result null and serialize last_checkpoint separately, including independently hashed best and final-valid transforms, objectives, accepted steps and selection-objective identity.
failure_evidence_contract.remaining_limit: An exceptional internal optimizer or provider error returned before a bounded result may still lack counters or a checkpoint; this receipt does not claim exhaustive evidence for arbitrary exceptions.

validation.focused_command: sbt -J-Xmx4G -Dsbt.supershell=false with StructuralCaptureSuite, AutomaticLinearPipelineSuite and LinearCostDiagnosticsSuite on reframe4s-flashalignJVM and reframe4s-flashalignJS
validation.focused_result: 12 passed on JVM and 12 passed on Scala.js; no failures or errors
validation.full_result: Flashalign JVM 153 passed; Flashalign Scala.js 152 passed; benchmark JVM 10 passed; no failures or errors
validation.automatic_regressions: Aligned identity skips expanded capture; displaced rigid and affine pairs execute capture; a capture rejection retains schedule and timings; deliberately exhausted candidates retain nonzero per-candidate and aggregate work, levels, checkpoints and timings with zero audit.
validation.allocation_observation: The JVM probe retained 24 allocated bytes at both 2000 and 20000 projected-patch iterations.
validation.repository_checks: Build graph 28 nodes and 95 edges; symbol ownership 1407 public qualified names and 66 owners; PRD 148 IDs, 28 nodes and 95 edges, acyclic; git diff --check clean.

ordinary_rigid.release_gate: all four succeed with landmark RMS at or below 0.1 mm

opened_cohort_development_result.comparison_to_l25: Median total time decreased from 4698 ms to 2710 ms, while successes decreased from 14 to 12. This is an opened-cohort development observation and cannot qualify accuracy or cost.

open_release_requirements: Preserve evidence for exceptional optimizer and evaluation failures that occur after work begins.
Freeze an independent unopened cohort and run sealed automatic linear accuracy without candidate-aware tuning.
Refresh whole-pipeline cost for that exact candidate, charging capture, all candidate attempts, final audit and output.
Keep GL and Flashalign-to-HalfFlow transfer blocked until the linear release gates pass.
claim_boundary: This receipt qualifies the coherent identity control flow, bounded failure evidence, evidence-row schema and cross-platform engineering regressions for the exact candidate. The opened development cohort fails the frozen accuracy and failure-tail gates. It is not fresh confirmation, MRI qualification, whole-pipeline cost qualification, linear release admission or authority to use Flashalign as a qualified HalfFlow initializer.
